Virtual Idol AppleTea’s Birthday Celebration on July 19

Jul 19, 2024
News Appletea

AppleTea, DimenCreat’s beloved virtual idol, celebrated her birthday on July 19 with a spectacular online event that brought fans together from all over the world.

The celebration featured exclusive performances by AppleTea, heartfelt messages from her supporters, and the release of limited-edition merchandise.

The event created a vibrant atmosphere where fans could interact, share their love for AppleTea, and be part of a memorable experience. It was a true testament to the strong bond between AppleTea and her dedicated community, highlighting her role as a cherished figure in the virtual idol world.
